hook: These People Will Struggle in the Age of Aquarius

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Stop. <#0.3#> If even one of these three fits you, watch to the end.
voices.caption: Stop. If even one of these three fits you, watch to the end.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: In December twenty twenty, the sky's clock changed. <#0.3#> The Age of Aquarius began.
voices.caption: In December 2020, the sky's clock changed. The Age of Aquarius began.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: One. People who only do what they're told. <#0.3#> No one's going to hand you the answers anymore.
voices.caption: One. People who only do what they're told. No one's going to hand you the answers anymore.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Two. People who grab and hold everything. <#0.3#> In this age, what you clutch slips away.
voices.caption: Two. People who grab and hold everything. In this age, what you clutch slips away.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Three. People who hide their own voice. <#0.3#> The moment you hide, your place disappears.
voices.caption: Three. People who hide their own voice. The moment you hide, your place disappears.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: How many fit you? <#0.3#> Just drop the number in the comments.
voices.caption: How many fit you? Just drop the number in the comments.
